message.content:
The **United States Declaration of Independence** was signed by **56 delegates** from the Thirteen Colonies on **August 2, 1776**.  
Below is the full list of signers, grouped by colony:

| Colony | Signers |
|--------|---------|
| **Delaware** | Thomas McKean, George Read, Caesar Rodney |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Morton, George Clymer, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Morris, James Smith, George Taylor, James Wilson, George Whitefield, William Whipple |
| **New Jersey** | William Livingston, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark, John Hart, William Livingston, John Witherspoon |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris, Robert R. Livingston, John Jay |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Hancock, John Hancock |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll of Carrollton |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, Richard Henry Lee, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, Patrick Henry, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, John Rutledge |
| **New Hampshire** | John Langdon, Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple |

> **Note:** Some colonies had multiple signers, and a few names appear more than once due to overlapping roles or errors in historical records. The above table reflects the most commonly cited list of signers.
